parts.name: frame body

physics.Basic_description: A black, C-shaped metal frame with a matte finish, forming the backbone of the clamp.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid structure against which the screw presses to clamp objects.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the vertical spine or the top/bottom arms of the C-frame firmly.
physics.reason: Cast iron clamps of this size are typically solid castings to withstand high clamping forces without bending.

parts.description: A black, C-shaped metal frame with a matte finish, forming the backbone of the clamp.
parts.function: Provides the rigid structure against which the screw presses to clamp objects.

parts.name: anvil pad

physics.Basic_description: A small, flat, silver-colored circular pad located at the bottom jaw of the frame.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a smooth, hard surface for the workpiece to rest against, distributing pressure.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to grasp independently; part of the jaw assembly.
physics.reason: Small functional pad made of solid metal to resist indentation.

parts.description: A small, flat, silver-colored circular pad located at the bottom jaw of the frame.
parts.function: Provides a smooth, hard surface for the workpiece to rest against, distributing pressure.

parts.name: screw core

physics.Basic_description: A silver threaded rod running through the center of the clamp frame.
physics.Functional_description: Converts rotational force from the handle into linear clamping force.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the threads, but slippery and not the primary manipulation point.
physics.reason: Threaded rods in clamps are solid steel to prevent buckling under compression.

parts.description: A silver threaded rod running through the center of the clamp frame.
parts.function: Converts rotational force from the handle into linear clamping force.

parts.name: screw collar

physics.Basic_description: A smooth silver cylindrical section on the screw shaft, likely a bearing surface or stop.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a spacer or bearing surface between the handle and the frame.
physics.Grasped_description: Small cylindrical section, not intended for grasping.
physics.reason: Integral part of the solid screw assembly.

parts.description: A smooth silver cylindrical section on the screw shaft, likely a bearing surface or stop.
parts.function: Acts as a spacer or bearing surface between the handle and the frame.

parts.name: handle hub

physics.Basic_description: The central silver block connecting the wings of the handle to the screw.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers torque from the handle wings to the screw shaft.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to turn the screw if the wings are obstructed.
physics.reason: Solid metal component required to transmit torque.

parts.description: The central silver block connecting the wings of the handle to the screw.
parts.function: Transfers torque from the handle wings to the screw shaft.

parts.name: pressing disc

physics.Basic_description: A silver circular disc at the tip of the screw that contacts the workpiece.
physics.Functional_description: Applies pressure to the object being clamped; often swivels to align with surfaces.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; it is the active end-effector of the tool.
physics.reason: Solid metal disc to distribute clamping force without deforming.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
